Role:

Location:
San Diego, CA (in-office)

At Seasats, the Program Manager is accountable for the successful execution of the company's external and internal projects. You will own the plan, the schedule, the budget, and the customer relationship on execution matters for projects ranging from complex customer contracts to participation in government and military exercises.

You coordinate complex and enduring projects, tasking and monitoring matrixed personnel from Engineering, Production, Fleet Operations, and Business Development who are assigned to your project but report to their own functional managers. Your job is to keep the plan, the schedule, the budget, and the customer aligned and moving forward.

As one of Seasats' primary points of accountability to the customer on contract execution, you'll work directly with government and military customers while coordinating internally across Engineering, Production, Fleet Operations, and Business Development. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on ownership, enjoys bringing structure to complex programs, and wants to help deliver autonomous maritime systems for missions that matter.

If you like being the person who makes sure the project goes to plan, on schedule, on budget, and to the customer's satisfaction, we'd love to hear from you.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Own the successful execution of assigned external and internal projects, including customer contracts, government/military exercises, and internal initiatives
Manage customer contracts and ensure successful delivery against contract terms
Support sales proposal efforts by defining project scope, schedule, and cost.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets
Track project hours and cash expenditures, in coordination with finance/accounting, and use that tracking to inform project invoicing
Coordinate the execution of project tasks by tasking and monitoring matrixed personnel assigned to the project by their functional managers
Plan and conduct internal and external meetings associated with assigned projects
Represent Seasats as the company's single point of contact on assigned projects
Author and/or coordinate project documentation deliverables
Identify and track project risks and develop mitigation plans

Contracted engineering and development projects to evaluate or deliver novel USV capabilities
Contracted USV maritime operations
Company participation in government and military exercises
Internal projects as tasked, including complex customer demonstrations and marketing initiatives

You are an organized, accountable Program Manager who enjoys owning outcomes rather than just tasks. You're comfortable managing a budget and a schedule with the same rigor you bring to a customer relationship, and you know how to get results from people who don't report to you.

You Enjoy Working With Government And Military Customers, Coordinating Across Engineering And Operations Teams, And Being The Person Who's Ultimately Answerable For Whether a Project Succeeds. You Have

Three years of experience as a Project/Program Manager on government contracts (required)
Experience as a PM on either small engineering development projects or maritime operations contracts
Demonstrated ability to develop and manage project plans, schedules, staffing plans, and budgets
Experience supporting proposal efforts by scoping cost, schedule, and technical approach
Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage a customer relationship on execution matters and to task and monitor matrixed personnel across functional teams
Demonstrated a proactive, organized approach to identifying risk and keeping projects on schedule and on budget
Proficiency with Microsoft’s suite of tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Project, Teams) for planning tracking, and reporting
Ability to obtain a Security Clearance
Due to export control requirements applicable to this position, we are only able to consider U.S. persons, as defined by U.S. export control laws. This includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and individuals granted asylee or refugee status

This position will require you to travel away from home and even outside the US for short periods of time; travel could consist of 25-35% for customer facing events and visits. Seasats provides a travel stipend while you're on the road, so you can expect to save money while on work trips.

In addition, it’s nice (though not essential) if you have:

PMP certification
Military experience
Ocean experience

About Seasats

At Seasats, we're passionate about delivering maritime robotics solutions to redefine the maritime industry. Our primary products are unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), designed to carry sensors at sea for months at a time. Our USVs provide persistent monitoring and data acquisition to defense, scientific, and commercial customers, and have autonomously crossed both the Pacific and Atlantic oceans. After thousands of years in which the only way to gather information from the ocean was to put people on a boat, these uncrewed vessels are transforming how humanity monitors and interacts with the ocean. Here, you’ll find the space and opportunity to do your life’s best work.

Stock options
Competitive insurance (including a 99% employer-covered Gold HMO plan or other options)
401k matching up to 4% of salary
Four free lunches per week

Catholic Charities of Acadiana is seeking a compassionate, organized, and mission-driven Tier 1 Case Manager to help individuals and families navigate financial crises and avoid homelessness. This role is ideal for someone who wants to make a meaningful impact through direct service while building a strong foundation in case management and social services. Your work will focus on emergency financial assistance, homelessness prevention, diversion, and short-term stabilization-helping clients resolve immediate crises and connect with the resources they need to move forward. Maintain accurate, timely electronic documentation and track services, referrals, and outcomes
